description:
Programme Overview

The Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) 2027/28 is run by Hong Kong's Research Grants Council (RGC). It awards 400 fully funded PhD fellowships across all disciplines at Hong Kong's eight UGC-funded universities. Each fellowship carries an annual stipend of HK$344,400 (approximately US$44,150) plus a HK$14,400 (approximately US$1,840) annual conference and research travel allowance.

Financial Coverage

  • Annual stipend of HK$344,400 (approximately HK$28,700 per month) paid for up to three years of full-time PhD study.
  • Conference and research-related travel allowance of HK$14,400 per year.
  • Beyond three years: additional support may be available directly from the chosen university.
  • Tuition arrangements vary by university; confirm with chosen institution's graduate school.

Participating Universities (8)

  • City University of Hong Kong (CityU)
  • Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU)
  • Lingnan University (LU)
  • The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)
  • The Education University of Hong Kong (EdUHK)
  • The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU)
  • The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST)
  • The University of Hong Kong (HKU)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Seeking admission as a new full-time PhD student at one of the eight participating universities.
  • All nationalities eligible.
  • Must satisfy admission requirements of chosen university and program.
  • Selection looks for: outstanding academic performance, excellent research ability and potential, communication and leadership abilities, international exposure.

Application dates

MilestoneDate
Applications open (HKPFSES)1 September 2026
RGC initial application deadline1 December 2026, 12:00 noon HKT
University application deadlinesEarly December 2026 (varies)
Results announcedBy May 2027
Fellowship beginsSeptember 2027

Application Process (Two-Stage)

Stage 1 - RGC Initial Application:

  • Register on HKPFSES at cerg1.ugc.edu.hk/hkpfs. No application fee.
  • Select up to two programs/departments at one or two universities.
  • Upload research proposal (typically 1,000 words), research experience, publications, and contact details of two academic referees.
  • Submit by 1 December 2026, 12:00 noon HKT.
  • Receive HKPFS Reference Number via email.

Stage 2 - Full University Application:

  • Submit full PhD admission application to chosen university(ies), quoting HKPFS Reference Number.
  • Requirements include: online application form, official transcripts, research proposal, personal statement, two academic recommendation letters.
  • University application fees apply (varies by institution, e.g., HKBU charges HK$450).
  • Deadlines vary by university, typically early December.

Official Links

  • HKPFS main page: https://cerg1.ugc.edu.hk/hkpfs/index.html
  • How to Apply: https://cerg1.ugc.edu.hk/hkpfs/apply.html
  • HKPFSES Initial Application System: https://cerg1.ugc.edu.hk/hkpfs/InitApp.do

Important Notes

  • Two-stage application is mandatory. Completing only one stage invalidates the fellowship application.
  • Register on HKPFSES early to secure Reference Number before university deadlines.
  • Referee reports must be completed within the tight December window.
  • Some university deadlines land within days of the RGC cutoff.

  • How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps
